theorems.name: Submission.second_fundamental_form_symm_normal_continuity
theorems.statement: ((∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M) → ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 2 M → (∀ y ∈ M, ∀ τ ∈ tangentSpace M y, ∀ η ∈ tangentSpace M y, secondFundamentalForm M y τ η = secondFundamentalForm M y η τ ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M y, inner ℝ (secondFundamentalForm M y τ η) v = 0) ∧ ContinuousOn (meanCurvature M) M ∧ ∀ (Y : Rn N → Rn N) (y : Rn N), y ∈ M → DifferentiableAt ℝ Y y → (∀ z ∈ M, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M z, inner ℝ (Y z) v = 0) → ∀ τ ∈ tangentSpace M y, ∀ η ∈ tangentSpace M y, inner ℝ η (fderiv ℝ Y y τ) = -inner ℝ (Y y) (secondFundamentalForm M y τ η)
